title: Wilbert Smith's secret role running radio monitoring in Ottawa

tellings.quote: He said, "He had a super top security clearance. He ran radio Ottawa."

plain: In the 1950s, the story goes, a Canadian government man named Wilbert B. Smith quietly ran radio monitoring in Ottawa and held a very high security clearance. A guest named Grant Cameron tells Michels this second-hand, passing on what a man named Art Bridge told him: "He had a super top security clearance. He ran radio Ottawa." If true, it would put Smith, who comes up in this subject's history, deep inside Canada's secret government work.
